description: The Kabayan–Lusod trail system traverses the highland ranges of Benguet in the Cordillera Administrative Region, connecting barangays across rugged mountain terrain. The area is characterised by a mosaic of pine forests, grasslands, and traditional Igorot communities that have inhabited the Cordilleras for centuries. Benguet province falls within the Cordillera Biogeographic Zone, one of the Philippines' most ecologically and culturally significant highland regions.
